Some of our employee benefits

Paid time off

  • Generous vacation days
  • Sick leave from day 1
  • Parental Leave Volunteering days

Health & well-being

  • Great breakfast in the office
  • Gym and Freefit Membership*

Be part of the drone economy, join the counter-drone revolution.

We’re relentlessly innovating and uniting to make the sky a safer place. Join us!

Join the fun and shape the drone economy

Drone innovation brings progress to the world. But it also comes with downsides and threats. At Sentrycs, we help our customers protect their facilities and people. We’re leading the way in protecting every organization from unauthorized commercial drone threats and enabling a safe drone-driven future. It’s a bold goal—and to succeed, we need passionate, talented people who want to make a real difference.

Whether in technical or business roles, excellence is what we aim for. To be the best, we bring authenticity, creativity, agility, and enthusiasm to our work. We don’t shy away from new challenges – we welcome them!
